items.t: SiriusXM stock slips as Anjali Sud named new CEO
items.sum: Investing.com -- Sirius XM Holdings Inc (NASDAQ:SIRI) shares ticked down 1% in premarket trading Monday following the announcement that Anjali Sud will become the company's next Chief Executive Officer.

SiriusXM today announced that Anjali Sud has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, effective January 1, 2027. This appointment follows Jennifer Witz's decision to step down as CEO following almost two and a half decades at the Company. Witz will remain in an advisory role at the Company until the end of 2027.
